_comment: Apps that are different ways to use the same service. Each family is shown as one app; its page lets the person pick a version that works on their device. Order matters: the first member this device can use is the one shown first. Mark anything not made by the service's owner as unofficial. 'os' (linux, windows, macos, android, ios) and 'form' (desktop, mobile, tv) say where a member runs; leave them out for one that runs wherever its source is.
